name: Engadin Airport (Samedan)

runway.v: one runway, 03/21, 1,840 m long and 40 m wide, asphalt/concrete

hours.v: open 0600Z to 1700Z in summer and 0700Z to 30 minutes after sunset in winter
hours.quote: Airport opening hours summer: 0600Z to 1700Z ... Airport opening hours winter: 0700Z to SS+30min

curfew.v: no night operations; closed outside opening hours (summer 0600Z-1700Z, i.e. 08:00-19:00 local; winter from 0700Z, i.e. 08:00 local, to 30 minutes after sunset)

ppr.v: PPR for IFR approaches with piston-engine aircraft and for multiple (training) IFR approaches
ppr.quote: PPR for IFR APCH with piston engine aircraft. ... PPR for multiple IFR APCH (training).

noise.v: operators must check that the aircraft type's noise class is allowed at Samedan
noise.quote: Make sure that the type of aircraft (noise class) is allowed to operate at Samedan airport.

customs.v: Swiss customs (FOCBS) services available during the airport's operating hours; not 24 hours
customs.quote: services at the Engadine Airport are available during operating hours

handling.v: handling by the airport is obligatory for all aircraft over 4,000 kg all year (and for helicopters up to 4,000 kg Dec-Apr)
handling.quote: Obligatory for all aircrafts > 4`000 kg Jan – Dec

fuel.v: Jet A-1 and Avgas available through the airport's ground handling

deicing.v: Type 1 de-icing offered by the airport's ground handling; the tariff lists categories up to Gulfstream IV/V, Global Express and a special category for Boeing 737

notes: Source is the operator's pilot familiarization briefing (v09/2025), which itself says to use the official AIP/VFR manual for flight preparation; the Swiss eAIP (skybriefing) is paid and was not used. Hours are given in UTC: summer 0600-1700Z = 08:00-19:00 CEST; winter opens 0700Z = 08:00 CET and closes 30 min after sunset, so the winter closure starts earlier than 19:00 (windows_local shows the summer window only; winter evening closure varies with sunset). Elevation 5,600 ft AMSL (2022 briefing v7.10: 'Elevation 5‘600 ft AMSL'). The briefing header shows coordinates 46°32'6"N 9°53'6"E, but not as an AIP ARP, so geo was left out. | 2026-10-30 run: Swiss eAIP (skybriefing, paid) not tried again beyond a search (no open link); BAZG customs-aerodrome list (20.12.2023) gives only phone contacts, no hours. Added from operator pages: customs (FOCBS services during operating hours, quote under 125 chars as the reader limited quote length), fuel (A1/Avgas), de-icing (type 1), and mandatory handling over 4,000 kg from the handling tariff. Caution: the tariff file is named 'ab 1.12.25' and was uploaded Jan 2026, but its text says 'Valid as of 01.12.2009'; the de-icing tariff (CHF 6.50/litre fluid, categories up to Boeing 737) is from that file. IATA SMV from the FOCA/BAZL Samedan page (ch-bazl-lszs): 'Code IATA : SMV'. Status set to verified: runway, curfew/hours (briefing v09/2025) and customs now recorded from operator sources; the official AIP was not read.
